name: Southern Natural Gas South System Expansion II Phase 1 loops
monitor_reason: not a new project: the 67.8 mi of loops and 51,650 hp of compression were a 2002 expansion that was already in service, so the pipe is part of the operating Southern Natural Gas system (P0252, 12,231 mi). No planned or proposed step remains. Adding a row would double count the operating system.
researcher_notes: Natural Gas Intelligence articles say Phase 1 of South System Expansion II adds 67.8 miles of looping and 51,650 horsepower of compression, with the loops tied in by August 27 and a requested in-service date of September 1, 2002. The year comes from the search summary of the Natural Gas Intelligence piece, not read directly because the site blocks plain downloads. The 67.8 mile length passes the 25 km rule, but the project is already built and sits inside the operating system row P0252. The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission docket CP02-01 in the consolidator note was not independently checked. The Energy Information Administration August 2026 release does not list this phase (it only lists later South System expansions, such as Phase 1A, which is a separate candidate). Recommend no new row. Existing row P7855 (South System Expansion 4) is a different, proposed project. Both articles are from the same publisher, so not independent.
